lean.statement:
(μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E
    let Z := fun y : E => ∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ
    (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
      (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (C*Z y)) ∧
    (∀ y, 0 < C*Z y) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 2 Z ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => -Real.log (C*Z y))
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space. mu is a probability measure, with no input density or finite-moment requirement. eta is a strictly positive real; dim E is Module.finrank R E, allowing zero.

stdGaussian E is the standard centered identity-covariance Gaussian; Measure.prod is independent product and Measure.map is pushforward. volume is canonical Lebesgue measure on the inner-product space. volume.withDensity(ofReal f) is the measure with nonnegative density f.

The integral is the real Bochner integral. Real.exp and Real.log are real exponential and logarithm. ContDiff R 2 means globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable. The displayed Gaussian normalizer and exact negative-log density are actual defined functions.
